messages:
sasha: noticed invoice preview drift after the new route-priority patch. small % of tokens are falling back to default SKU.
rene: which patch? the header-normalization tweak?
devon: yes, that patch drops legacy route_hint header for older clientlibs. we may be losing route_resolution_id in some proxy flows.
sasha: sample event shows null route_resolution_id and session_id present.
billing-bot: alert: preview delta 0.4% for 9 tenants. estimated preview impact ~$650.
rene: immediate steps: 1) pause rollout 2) add short-lived fallback in preview job to consult session->last_route cache 3) run query to enumerate tenants with >20 nulls in the 10:10-10:30 window.
deploy-bot: rollback started for routing-priority canary -> 3% -> 0%.
devon: i can add a fallback write on resolution to route-cache (ttl 48h) and ship to canary nodes in 20m.
sasha: i'll run the detection query and kick off preview backfill for tenants over threshold. liaison with billing to hold invoice finalization for affected accounts.
rene: also add metric ingest.route_resolution_lost and alert if > 3/min to catch regressions during future rollouts.
billing-bot: backfill job queued for 9 tenants. status: pending.
sasha: thanks team. will update once backfill completes or if more tenants show up.
